subject: SIG follow-up: SDLC change telemetry + secrets handover
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia@acmerisk.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: SDLC change telemetry + secrets handover

Hi Olivia / Acme team,

Thanks again for the quick SIG review call this morning. Per our discussion I pulled together the artifacts you requested that demonstrate our secure SDLC controls focused on change telemetry, PR gating, and secrets handling.

Quick summary of what's attached and where to look:
- sdlc-runbook-2025-10.pdf: runbook excerpt showing approval flows, roles, and canary rollback steps (see pages 6-9 for change telemetry hooks).
- ci-job-logs-20250930.zip: redacted CI job logs for the October 1 canary rollout (contains CI step names and job IDs; we redacted dynamic ephemeral token values).
- commit-provenance-202509.csv: CSV export of commits, PR IDs, author, signing status, and build artifacts SHA.

Outstanding items from your list where we still need to confirm specifics:
1) Exact retention window for change telemetry events in our trace store — we keep detailed traces for 90 days and aggregated metrics for 2 years.
2) A sample of signed commit verification for the release branch (I included the CSV but will add GPG verification snippets if you want).
3) The ephemeral secret rotation proof for the vault integration (Rishi is looping in the vault policy and rotation cadence).

Next steps: please confirm which specific PR IDs or date ranges you'd like us to expand on and Rishi will produce the additional audit snippets.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdlc-runbook-2025-10.pdf (PDF), ci-job-logs-20250930.zip (ZIP), commit-provenance-202509.csv (CSV)
From: Olivia Turner <olivia@acmerisk.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Risk - SIG Assessment <sig-assess@acmerisk.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SDLC change telemetry + secrets handover

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few quick asks so we can close the evidence loop for FinSight's SIG: 

1) For change telemetry retention: can you provide the raw event export for one day (we only need anonymized event IDs and timestamps) and confirm retention policy in writing?
2) For signed commits: please include the verification output for three commits from the CSV (preferably one merge commit and two direct commits).
3) For secrets proof: we need the vault rotation runbook and the last rotation job invocation log (you can redact hostnames but not job IDs).

Also, we noticed the CI logs reference a job named "canary-deploy-prod" — can you confirm the exact gating policy that ensures that job only runs after PR approvals and QA sign-off? If there is a concise policy snippet or a policy id in Vault/Jenkins/GitHub Actions that we can reference, that would be ideal.

If possible, can you provide the additional pieces by Monday Oct 6 so we can finalize the SIG response for FinSight?

Best,
Olivia Turner
Senior Assessor, Acme Risk

Hi Olivia — looping in details you requested. I focused on providing the minimal redacted artifacts per your ask.

1) Change telemetry export (anonymized): attached a single-day export (events-20251001-anon.csv) with only event_id, timestamp, change_type, actor_role, and outcome columns. Retention policy: 90 days for raw traces; 2 years for aggregated metrics.

2) Signed commit verification: below are three verification snippets (merge commit + two direct commits). We verified with our internal GPG key and the CI trust pipeline (signing happens at merge).
- PR #1421 merge: commit 9f3c2a (verified: GPG: OK)
- Commit 9b1a7e: "fix/rotate-ttl" (verified: GPG: OK)
- Commit 8d4f6c: "docs/runbook-update" (verified: GPG: OK)

3) Vault rotation proof: attached rotation-job-20251001.log (redacted) showing job id vault-rot-20251001 and start/end timestamps. Rotation cadence: daily for ephemeral CI credentials, weekly for service tokens, and 90-day KMS key rotation for long-lived keys. Vault policies are referenced via policy IDs: policy-sdli-01 (service tokens) and policy-ci-ephemeral-07 (CI ephemeral).

Gating policy for "canary-deploy-prod":
- The job only executes on the protected release branch after:
  a) 2 approvers on the PR (code owners + at least one security reviewer)
  b) CI green on the full integration suite (job group: int-suite-v3)
  c) Manual QA signoff step (jira SUP-1129 is our current QA ticket)

I attached the small text snippets you asked for and added links to the Drive folder where full logs live (redacted for public sharing). If you need raw logs without redactions we can produce them under an encrypted transfer.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Reliability & Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: events-20251001-anon.csv (CSV), rotation-job-20251001.log (LOG)
